name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The user aims to easily find nearby recycling centers, view their operational hours, and access maps for navigation, streamlining their recycling efforts.
The user wants to be informed about new recycling events, facility updates, and other relevant information to stay engaged and participate effectively.
The user expects to have an account where they can manage their profile, favorite facilities, and personal settings.
The user desires a channel to communicate feedback, report issues, or ask for help, ensuring their concerns are addressed and contributing to service improvement.

The user aims to schedule flexible pickup times and receive recommendations for recycling centers that fit their weekly schedule, considering different types of recyclable waste for optimal routing and convenience.
The user wants to receive tempting rewards to incentivize their continued use of the website.
The user wants to view user documentation to understand how to effectively use the web application's features.
The administrator aims to maintain the accuracy and currency of all recycling facility data, including adding, removing, and updating information, to provide reliable service to users.
The administrator seeks to efficiently review and respond to user feedback and complaints to identify areas for improvement and enhance user satisfaction.
The administrator needs to establish and maintain direct communication channels with facility representatives to keep them informed about website features and address any concerns.
The facility representative aims to independently update their facility's information, including operational hours and accepted materials, to ensure accuracy and avoid miscommunication with users.
The facility representative desires a direct channel to convey any issues or concerns they have to the site administrators for prompt resolution.
The superuser aims to update recycling center information to provide the most current and accurate details to users, enhancing the reliability of the platform.
The superuser seeks to efficiently answer user questions related to recycling centers, ensuring users receive the information they need promptly.
The company aims to easily upload or delete information on the website, ensuring their facility details are accurately represented.
lowLevelGoals: The system should enable users to input their current location or a desired area and specify the types of waste they want to recycle, returning a filtered list of relevant facilities.
The system should display comprehensive details for a chosen facility, including its address, operational hours, accepted materials, contact information, and user reviews.
The system should integrate with a mapping service to offer turn-by-turn directions from the user's current location to the chosen recycling facility.
The system should enable users to mark specific recycling facilities as 'favorites' for quick access in the future.
The system should allow users to opt-in to receive alerts about upcoming recycling events based on their location or preferred waste types.
The system should send alerts to users when there are changes to the operational hours, accepted materials, or other key information for facilities they have marked as favorites.
The system should provide a settings interface where users can control the types of notifications they receive, their frequency, and delivery methods (e.g., email, in-app).
The system should enable users to register for an account, log in, and update their personal information such as name, email, and password.
The system should display a dedicated section in the user's account where they can see all the facilities they have marked as favorites and remove them if desired.
The system should provide options for users to configure various application settings, such as language, theme, and privacy controls.
The system should provide a form where users can submit text-based feedback, suggestions, or report technical issues they encounter.
The system should provide a mechanism for users to track the progress of their feedback or support tickets, including administrator responses.
The system should allow users to select a date and time for a recycling pickup, specifying the types and estimated quantities of waste to be collected.
The system should analyze the user's specified waste types and their location to suggest an efficient route visiting multiple recycling centers that accept those materials.
The system should provide a calendar or list view where users can see their upcoming scheduled pickups or planned visits, with options to modify or cancel them.
The system should automatically assign reward points to users when they successfully schedule a pickup, visit a facility, or perform other designated recycling activities.
The system should display the user's accumulated reward points in their profile or a dedicated rewards section.
The system should provide a catalog of rewards (e.g., vouchers, discounts) that users can exchange their accumulated points for.
The system should provide a dedicated section with frequently asked questions and detailed answers about using the web application.
The system should include a search functionality within the help section to allow users to quickly find relevant information.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to input all necessary details for a new recycling facility, including name, address, contact, hours, and accepted materials.
The system should allow administrators to modify any details of an already listed recycling facility, such as operational hours, accepted materials, or contact information.
The system should provide a function for administrators to delete a recycling facility entry, ensuring it is no longer visible to users.
The system should provide a dashboard or list view for administrators to access all user-submitted feedback, issues, and complaints.
The system should provide a communication tool within the platform for administrators to send direct replies to users regarding their feedback or support inquiries.
The system should allow administrators to assign categories (e.g., bug, feature request, general inquiry) and priority levels to incoming feedback for better management.
The system should provide a messaging feature for administrators to communicate directly with registered facility representatives.
The system should log and display past communications between administrators and facility representatives for reference.
The system should provide a secure login mechanism for facility representatives to access a dedicated portal for their facility.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the opening and closing times for their recycling center.
The system should provide a tool for facility representatives to add or remove types of recyclable materials their facility accepts.
The system should provide a dedicated form or messaging system for facility representatives to report problems or ask questions to the site administrators.
The system should display replies from administrators to the issues or concerns submitted by facility representatives.
The system should provide a high-privilege interface for superusers to modify any detail of a recycling center, bypassing standard approval workflows if necessary.
The system should present a queue of proposed changes from facility representatives for superusers to review and either publish or decline.
The system should provide superusers with a centralized inbox or dashboard to view and reply to all questions submitted by users.
The system should provide a status update mechanism for superusers to indicate when a user's question has been fully addressed.
The system should provide an interface for companies to submit details for new recycling facilities they operate, subject to administrative review.
The system should provide a function for companies to request the removal of their facility's information from the website, subject to administrative approval.
The system should display the locations of public recycling bins on an interactive map interface.
The system should display the locations of special waste drop-off sites on an interactive map interface.
The system should provide a dedicated section or calendar displaying details of scheduled safe disposal events, including dates, times, and locations.
The system should provide a clickable link or button next to a facility's address that, when activated, opens the location in a user's default mapping application (e.g., Google Maps).
The system should allow users to apply a filter to search results to display only facilities that are designated as 'environment-friendly' or have specific environmental certifications.
The system should provide an interface for users to input or upload their weekly availability, which will then be used to generate time-based recommendations for recycling visits.
The system should validate user-entered zip codes during facility searches and display an error message or suggestion if the input is invalid or unrecognized.
